publication_copy.headline: THREE DIVISIONS. DIFFERENT PRESSURES.
publication_copy.deck: The same results change three separate races
publication_copy.body: Six teams now share 6–4 records. Pizza contains three of them; Wings two; Burgers one. The same record creates different pressure in each division. Week 11 is the final crossover before Weeks 12–14 bring division opponents back together.

callouts.label: BURGERS
callouts.heading: D0nkey K0ng has separation
callouts.body: D0nkey K0ng is 6–4; ObiWan Jacoby and Three Dreaded Snake are 4–6; Mud Dogs is 2–8. Beating ObiWan Jacoby in Week 12 and Three Dreaded Snake in Week 13 secures D0nkey K0ng’s division title.

callouts.label: PIZZA
callouts.heading: Three leaders on the same step
callouts.body: El Niño, His Majesty’s Blood and Seven Deadly Chins are all 6–4. The LLC’s 203.96 victory lifts its record to 4–6, with the divisional return still ahead.

callouts.label: WINGS
callouts.heading: The cushion has narrowed
callouts.body: Dr. Duckhook and Slob on my Dobb are 6–4; Red Leopards and The Chili Cheesers are 5–5. Red Leopards went 3–0 in the first divisional pass; winning all four remaining games secures Wings.

publication_copy.headline: FOUR MORE AFTER THIS
publication_copy.body: All twelve teams still have a route, and none has clinched. Four games remain: one crossover, then three divisional rounds. Nine wins guarantees a berth; eight alone does not. A 6–8 finish can give Mud Dogs either a Burgers title or a shared place. Record scenarios assume no tied games.

callouts.heading: SEVEN BERTHS
callouts.body: Three division winners and four shared places.

callouts.heading: MUD DOGS’ NEXT TEST
callouts.body: A Week 11 loss to Seven Deadly Chins eliminates Mud Dogs. Winning keeps a narrow, help-dependent route alive.

publication_copy.headline: THE NEXT SIX
publication_copy.deck: Week 11 • Head-to-head stakes before the divisional finish
publication_copy.body: Four 6–4 contenders meet in two top-seed contests. The two 4–6 hosts need to close ground on the 5–5 visitors; The LLC needs recovery against Dr. Duckhook. These are not automatic eliminators. Only Mud Dogs is eliminated by a Week 11 loss. Head-to-head can decide ties; three divisional rounds follow.

callouts.heading: BUBBLE SWING · THEFFHUB
callouts.body: Nov. 17, 2026. Each team’s playoff estimate after its Week 11 win / loss: ObiWan Jacoby 52% / 13%; The Chili Cheesers 58% / 21%. Other games simulated; 10,000 runs from season scores, excluding projections and NFL byes.
